Swarnendu Moitra (Bengali: স্বর্ণেন্দু মৈত্র ) is an Indian researcher in the field of Neurolinguistics. He works at Queen Mary University of London. in the [https://morphlab.sllf.qmul.ac.uk Morphemes and Meaning Lab] on the ESRC funded [https://savant.qmul.ac.uk/ SAVANT Project]
